h: Seaside Road and the eastern seafront
p: Seaside Road is the long street running parallel to the front east of the town centre, and it's a handy spot whether you're staying in one of the guesthouses nearby or wandering along from the pier.

Head east and you'll reach the Redoubt Fortress, a Napoleonic-era fort on the seafront, and keep going and you'll eventually hit Sovereign Harbour. In the other direction there's the pier and the bandstand, with Beachy Head and the start of the South Downs beyond the western end of town. Admiral is an 18+ adult gaming centre, so the kids will need to stick to the seaside amusements. There's no shortage of fish and chips, cafés and takeaways along this stretch for a bite before or after.
